system.description:
You will be able to use [Potion] with an IR of [CR+2] or less. The "recovery medicine (regardless of grade)" you use will be added to the [HP] recovery amount + [INT base value]. The "regenerative medicine (regardless of grade)" you use is +[INT] to the strength of [regenerate].

You are good at handling potions. If you know how to store and use your medicines, your medicines will work wonders.
